spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the Hawaiian Islands region with extensive white cumulus and cirrus cloud cover across most of the scene and a broad dense white cloud mass in the south. Dark ocean is visible in patches to the west and north. Island landmasses on the east side are partly visible through clouds. No distinct thin gray haze or streak distinguishable from ordinary clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Precursory overflows from the north vent continue for the third day. All vents have strong glow, with overflows and intermittent spatter from the north vent. There is no anomalous activity outside of the summit.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts increased in August, while the summit region showed no other signs of deformation. Mauna Loa had an increase in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 87 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the August reporting period, after 57 in July. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
